entities.name: Curse of the Chain Veil
entities.description: A 4556 AR confrontation involving Liliana, Garruk and Kothophed.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker bound to Kothophed who acquired the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker cursed by Liliana using the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon to whom Liliana was bound, destroyed by the Veil.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: A relic of the ancient ogre civilization haunted by Onakke spirits.

entities.name: Onakke Catacombs
entities.description: Catacombs on Shandalar where the Veil was kept.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: Ancient ogre civilization whose spirits haunt Liliana.

entities.name: Ursoth
entities.description: A native beast Garruk was hunting.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: Part of whose essence the Veil preserved.

events.summary: On Kothophed's command Liliana travels to the Onakke Catacombs to retrieve the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Liliana traveled to the Onakke Catacombs on Shandalar to retrieve the Chain Veil

events.summary: Liliana slays a native beast, drawing Garruk's wrath; he attacks her in the temple.
events.quote: Garruk tracked her into the temple and attacked

events.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to drive Garruk back and curses him.
events.quote: Liliana drove Garruk back, cursing him in the process.

events.summary: Liliana confronts Kothophed and destroys him with the Veil, freeing herself from his bond.
events.quote: His death freed her from his bond

events.summary: The Veil's Onakke spirits begin haunting Liliana, and it binds itself to her.
events.quote: The artifact had bound itself to her, resisting all attempts to be discarded.

relations.note: Bound in service before she turned on him.
relations.quote: to whom she was bound in service
she unleashed the Veil's power to destroy him utterly

relations.note: She cursed him; he vowed to hunt her.
relations.quote: Garruk vowed to hunt Liliana across the planes in search of a cure.
